name: California FFA and Supervised Agricultural Experience (SAE)
org: California FFA and National FFA Organization
what_you_do: You learn agriculture in class. You run a hands-on Supervised Agricultural Experience. It can be a job or a project. You build leadership through events.
who_can_apply: Join through a school that has an agricultural education program; chapters are chartered in schools with ag classes. California reports over 103,000 members. Age and grade rules were not on the pages I read.
pay_detail: Dues are not stated on the pages read. Ask your ag teacher what your chapter charges.
duration: School year; SAE can be year-round
how_to_apply: Take an agriculture class at a school with an FFA chapter.
notes: Not every school has an FFA chapter. Ask your counselor or ag teacher. Age and grade limits and dues were not on the California or National FFA pages I read.
